021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.localization.text.ProxiedLocale;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
023import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.SignRenderSnapshot;
024import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
025import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
026import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
027
028/**
029 * ControlComponent
030 *
031 * @author creatorfromhell
032 * @since 6.3.0.0
033 */
034public interface RenderComponent {
035
036  /**
037   * Returns the placeholder string associated with the render component.
038   *
039   * @return the placeholder string
040   */
041  String placeholder();
042
043  /**
044   * Determines if the given line contains the placeholder string
045   * associated with the render component.
046   *
047   * @param line the line to check against the placeholder, must not be null
048   * @return {@code true} if the line contains the placeholder, {@code false} otherwise
049   */
050  default boolean appliesTo(@NotNull final String line) {
051
052    return line.contains(placeholder());
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Determines if this render component is a full line replacement.
057   * If it is a full line replacement, no other renderers will be run
058   * on the same line, and the rendering process will skip to the next line.
059   *
060   * @return {@code true} if this is a full line replacement, {@code false} otherwise.
061   */
062  boolean fullLine();
063
064  /**
065   * Determines if this render component supports snapshot rendering.
066   *
067   * @return {@code true} if snapshot rendering is supported, {@code false} otherwise.
068   */
069  boolean supportsSnapshot();
070
071  /**
072   * Renders the snapshot of the current state of the {@link SignRenderSnapshot}.
073   * This method is responsible for rendering a visual representation of the
074   * shop based on the details provided in the snapshot.
075   *
076   * @param snapshot the {@link SignRenderSnapshot} containing all the data required
077   *             to render a representation of the shop, must not be null
078   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the components
079   * @return a {@link Component} representing the rendered snapshot output
080   */
081  Component renderSnapshot(@NotNull final SignRenderSnapshot snapshot, final ProxiedLocale locale);
082
083  /**
084   * Renders a component based on the provided shop and item data.
085   *
086   * @param shop the shop instance containing all relevant data needed for rendering, must not be null
087   * @param item the item stack representing the item associated with the shop, must not be null
088   * @param locale the locale to be used for rendering the components, defining language and formatting settings
089   * @return a {@link Component} representing the rendered output based on the provided shop and item data
090   */
091  Component render(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final ItemStack item, final ProxiedLocale locale);
092}
